subject: t-c-imp
title: T.C.IMP.------RT.DY.
description: Chart on book p. 397 (R(AS)CM(II)-41). T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) is the subject; RT-DY (reality dynamics) is the partner. From the subject: EXP-DY (expansion dynamics), PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) and POL-P (political policies). From EXP-DY: PER-TR (perceived transformation) and CULT-AF-B (culture affinity basis). From PROG-CONT: TRS (transition). From POL-P: MOT-DY. From CULT-AF-B: INFO-DY (information dynamics). From MOT-DY: AFTD (affinity tendencies).
